metas.name: Latin - Croatia, Montenegro, Serbia Shared Latin Letters
metas.note:
• Countries: Croatia, Montenegro, Serbia
  • Info: The lowercase đ is reasonably rare because most words containing đ have it as the first letter, or are in all caps on shop signs, so the upper case letter is often used, however the lower case can be seen occasionally. Much more likely to be found in Croatia just due to there being more coverage there.
  • Warnings: đ is the lower case form of Đ (D with stroke), not to be confused with the almost identical Đ (Eth) which is found in Bosnian, Serbian & Croatian.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Latin - France Unique Latin Letters
metas.note:
• Countries: France
  • Info: While the Œ ligature, unique to French, is found in other French speaking countries, in practice it will usually be expanded to OE, so if you see it on signage within Europe, you are far more likely to be in France.

metas.name: Latin - Turkiye Unique Latin Letters
metas.note:
• Countries: Turkiye
  • Info: İi, while a distinct letter, can obviously be confused with other forms of i. It's quite recognisable on signs as Turkish though, so it's been included.
  • Warnings: Be careful not to confuse Şş with the Romanian Șș. Ğğ can also be found in Sami regions.
